decisions.reason: The firm has invested heavily in a multi-model range with a dedicated page, and the product remains central with no reported problems, so escalation of commitment keeps it.
Its own page and quantified launch signal public commitment, and it builds on the established offer with no problems, so the firm will persist.
The quantified launch and established-offer fit create enough commitment to keep this product despite lower visibility.
Although only mentioned on the website, it builds on the established offer and has incurred investment, so the firm maintains commitment.
Distant from the established offer and facing a quality problem that is not clearly temporary, this product lacks the centrality and justification for continued commitment, so it is likely dropped.
The firm invested in a dedicated page and launched it publicly, and with no reported problems it will persist despite being distant from the established offer.
